claim: Adding an SAE feature's direction steers generation toward its concept (a bridge feature; Golden Gate analogue)
published: clamping the Golden Gate Bridge feature makes Claude 3 Sonnet obsessed with the bridge (Templeton et al. 2024)
ours: GPT-2 small layer 8, feature #17608: completions mentioning the bridge 0% [0, 7] → 77% [63, 87] at α = 40 (random direction 0% [0, 7]); 'Golden Gate' or 'San Francisco' named in 0% [0, 7] (n = 48 per cell; Wilson 95% CIs)
criterion: ≥ 50% on-topic and ≥ 30 points above baseline and random
post_hoc: feature-selection rule changed twice after smoke tests that showed steering outcomes
